$comment: Single source of truth for code coverage minimums. Read by scripts/check-coverage.mjs
in CI and by each package's vitest/jest config so a local `npm run test:coverage`
enforces exactly what the pull request gate enforces.
Minimums are a RATCHET: scripts/check-threshold-ratchet.mjs fails any pull request
that lowers one. Raise them as coverage improves; see docs/CODE_COVERAGE.md.
Per-package values were set by measuring current coverage and rounding down, so the
gate is green on the current tree while still catching regressions. Packages listed
below the `defaults` are carrying known test debt and should climb toward it.
Minimum coverage for lines a pull request adds or changes, measured by diff-cover.
Held higher than the whole-package minimums: new code has no excuse for being
untested, and this is what pulls packages carrying test debt back up over time.

clipper.note: Below defaults: branch coverage in the extraction fallbacks needs work.

recipe-app.note: Below defaults: large React surface with partial component coverage.

shared.note: Below defaults: kv-storage and nutrition-calculator are exercised by standalone node scripts that do not report coverage.

user-management-worker.note: Below defaults: the existing suites are thin smoke tests. Highest-priority package to improve.
